items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: And Kid Punch was in his prime and he had a good band, too, you see.

ctx.x: I know he used to play with Avery and Tillman uptown when I heard him up by the park. Yeah.

At Tom Harris. Well, I guess that's about the same ones, you know. He had a band... That band was operating from Colton. That's the band that was way up in Colton. And he got that job out of Lincoln Beach. And that's a good bass. It's brand new. When I got it... He hadn't used it two years. You like new basses better than old basses? Oh, yeah. I can... I don't know. I like a new instrument. I used to have an old bass. It was called... Maple. It was a pure maple bass. And I used that bass and patched it up in…
I wonder about that. What bands did you play with when you'd be advertising?

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: when Kid Punch first came here from the country, the trumpet player, he had Kid Punch with him.

ctx.x: Can you remember who was band?
Uh, he had, well, he had, um, he had, well, he first, when Kid Punch first came here from the country, the trumpet player, he had Kid Punch with him.
I didn't know that we see Punch all the time.
